question: Related Questions Q. Sometime back I saw a dream and I would be grateful if u could give me tabeer for the same. I saw that I am standing just outside my house in the lane. Some lions are approaching me from the other end. I am a little scared. But when they come close to me, the lions become meek and submissive. And I realise that though I was afraid of them, they are actually here to help and protect me. Soon, I see these lions stand next to me to counter the lions coming from the opposite direction. Pl guide with a tabeer. 1456 views Q. Please interpret this dream according to your knowledge. Jazakhumakhair. 1427 views Q. Last year i saw a dream in the time of morning( that day i was a little late for my fajr prayer. I saw that my family members are mourning. I ask what has happened. My sister says that "be quite. Masood is dead(i am masood myself).i am very worried that how is it possible because i am alive .i see a person lying on the ground on white kafan and people are gathered around my dead body. I rise one corner of kafan to see who is inside. i see myself. my body is in a very bad condition. My skin peels( sheds) like the plastic paints on the wall when it get moist. i become very afraid and wake up. since then i am very upset about my future. I pray five times a say and alhamdulillah trying act on all quran and sunnah teachings. I asked many ulama. some said it is a good dream to see yourself dead. But i am very upset about my condition of dead body. PLEASE tell me the ta'beer of this dream I will pray for you and your whole team that may Allah bless you all and enable you to serve the whole humanity and like other deoband ulama, keep the light of Islam shining on these dark days of ignorance. thank you 3839 views Q. asslamualaikum. his hands which is glowing n he says to us that dont worry Allah has written ur name in this book he did not specify that we were to get married but thats how i took it n i was very happy in my dream n running around the roof and looking down so that i can see a beautiful scenery but all i could see was barren land n dry trees.that time i was young n presumed that this dream meant that we will get marrid but will not be happy after that.During this time i always prayed to allah that pls decide my destiny to be with him only if u feel it is better for both of us. time passed n my father went and gave his words to one of his friends for my marriage without asking me but now that he had fixed it all up i did not have the heart to oppose him. i stopped talking to that guy n so did he.but since thhat there is a drem that i have been having which really diturbs me is that i see in my dream that i meet him somewhere or i am looking for his phone no so that i can ask him to forgive me or someting like i m making him meet my husband and my 3 yr old son alot more dreams but of the same type it really troubls me n i feel that i am cheating on my husband though after our engagement i had told him everyting about my past amd he forgave me for being honest i often pray to allah not to show me such dreams i dont kow what to do it has been 5 yrs now and every week i see a dream related to him is it a sub concious guilt of breaking a promise or what i fail to undrstang . i have a very beautiful relation with my husband n thins like me distract me a lot pls tell me what is the meaning of answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 12226 Country: Canada Title: a-o-a I had a dream about my uncle around a year later after his death were I see my self praying in the front row of a Friday prayer with all levels of people gathered. Then when I turn around, I see my uncle talking and laughing at his son explaining that in life he should take responsibility and that my uncle is safe and health. From physical description I see him in white cloths, well built in muscle, happy looking, with a black sheet covering his left side and stuff like kajal, topi, small beard, white skin even if he was a bit brown before death. I feel like everything isn?t right, as if I have been shown this dream to take care of his family. The first thought I had when I awake from the dream was marrying his daughter who I haven?t seen yet. What should be done, and what from your knowledge this dream really means? I was told by my parents that they are converting to chiasm and they are so young, I am in my 20ties and am not strong enough to be trusted by them. I feel really worried. By Muhammed Faizan Mustafa My second question is that I see him again in a second dream a few months later were he is looking at me in a cloudy crowd, but I am not so confident about it because it was short and more of a vision then a dream. What does this mean and what does he want me to do. Why do I see this dream when I have never lived with him by.
